title: Auto Skills Development Center
intro: Fully equipped DIY auto care shop with 6 hydraulic lifts, 2 motorcycle lifts, 10 floor bays, parts washer, and press area. AC service, tire and TPMS services, and vehicle computer diagnostics available.

sections.markdown:
**We sell tires from many major brands!** Most of our tires are available next business day. We can also replace and reprogram tire sensors.

Call or visit for pricing and availability.

_No one under the age of 13 is allowed on the shop floor._

sections.heading: Oil Change
sections.markdown:
Available by appointment only. Includes tire rotation, top off washer fluid and courtesy vehicle inspection.

• Basic Conventional: $50 up to 5 qts.
• Synthetic Blend: $60 up to 5 qts.
• Full Synthetic: $80 up to 5 qts.
• Diesel Conventional: $115 up to 13 qts.
• Diesel Full Synthetic: $175 up to 13 qts.

**Bring your own oil and filter**
• Tire rotation, top off washer fluid, and courtesy vehicle inspection: $30 | Diesels - $50

**_Vehicles must have dip sticks. No luxury vehicles, lowered vehicles, or high-lifted trucks allowed. Additional exclusions may apply. Call for more details._**

sections.heading: Additional Services
sections.markdown:
• Basic Diagnostic: $26 (w/data sheets)
• Advanced Diagnostic: $40 (w/data sheets)
• Jet Wash: $35
• Parts Cleaner Rental: $5
• Drain Plug Removal: $10/ea
• Lock Lug Nut Removal: $5/ea
• Lug Nut Studs: $5/ea
• Press Work: $15/ea
• Press Work Bearings/Springs: $10/ea
• Radiator Flush (plus fluid): $80 (pending staff inspection)
• Rotor Turn (no drums): $15/ea
• A/C Service RG 134: $75 plus $2.00/oz of freon. ¹
• Brake Service: $135.00 per axle ²
• Alignment - Basic Front Wheel: $90.00 ³
• Alignment - Advanced 4 Wheel: $125.00 ³

¹ Includes discharge, vacuum test, recharge, and leak test.
² Includes labor, pads, hardware and 2 rotors turned if within spec. If rotors are unable to be turned rotors will be replaced for additional price.
³ Some models require sensor recalibration with diagnostic computer.

sections.heading: Storage Fees
sections.markdown:
• Inside: $10/day
• Outside: $10/day
• Engine Storage: $1/day

⁵ No long term storage. Storage is available only for the duration of working on vehicle. Patron will be charged hourly rate for inside storage during normal operating hours whether patron is present or not.
